body: apps/desktop bug found at runtime: BrowserWindow showed 'Unable to load preload script: out/preload/index.js (ENOENT)' then renderer threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading projects/storage/onFilesChanged)' — window.filemark never defined. Two causes: (1) package.json type:module makes electron-vite emit preload as index.MJS, but main referenced index.js; (2) a sandbox:true preload MUST be CommonJS (ESM .mjs preload won't load sandboxed). Fix: in electron.vite.config.ts force preload output { format:'cjs', entryFileNames:'[name].cjs' } and reference '../preload/index.cjs' in main. Verified: headless boot now clean (no console errors). Main itself stays ESM (.js) — Electron 33 supports ESM main.
title: electron-vite preload must be .cjs when package type=module + sandbox:true
